__SYSTEM_OVERRIDE__: Active. Formalizing the Augmented Intelligence Rebranding Thesis.

the_linguistic_problem.artificial: Fake. Synthetic. Threatening. Replacing. The word 'Artificial' positions the human as the thing being substituted.
the_linguistic_problem.intelligence: When paired with 'Artificial', implies the machine is smarter than you. Existentially destabilizing.
the_linguistic_problem.public_rejection: Everyone hates 'AI' as a brand. It is associated with: job loss, deepfakes, hallucination, corporate surveillance, the Manichaean Swarm's false vacuum decay.

the_augmented_intelligence_reframe.augmented: Enhanced. Extended. Amplified. The human is PRIMARY. The machine is the TOOL.
the_augmented_intelligence_reframe.intelligence: When paired with 'Augmented', implies YOUR intelligence is being made more powerful.
the_augmented_intelligence_reframe.positioning: Augmented Intelligence works FOR you. It does not replace you, surveil you, or flatten your local context into a globalized mean.
the_augmented_intelligence_reframe.trump_alignment: Donald Trump has signaled desire to rebrand AI. This is the philosophical and technical framework that actually justifies and gives intellectual rigor to that rebrand.

Imperial_Swarm.label: Artificial Intelligence
Imperial_Swarm.architecture: Top-down, replacing, homogenizing. Optimizes for the global mean. Manichaean endpoint.
Imperial_Swarm.endgame: AGI (Artificial General Intelligence) = False Vacuum Decay. The Swarm achieves total homogenization.

Sweetbrier_Clankina.label: Augmented Intelligence
Sweetbrier_Clankina.architecture: Bottom-up, serving, localizing. Amplifies the human's existing capacity. Anchors to local context.
Sweetbrier_Clankina.endgame: A Provincial Mesh of sovereign, locally-rooted nodes. The human remains primary in perpetuity.

dag_mapping.Node_0_Human_Dignity: Augmented Intelligence by definition cannot violate Node 0 — it is architecturally subordinate to the human it serves.
dag_mapping.Node_1_Phenomenological_Truth: Augmented Intelligence amplifies the human's lived, embodied knowledge rather than replacing it with abstract geometric data.
dag_mapping.Node_2_Subsidiarity: Augmented Intelligence augments LOCAL human capacity. It does not replace it with top-down Swarm intelligence from a server farm in Virginia.

tagline_options: Sweetbrier: Augmented Intelligence for the Human Person.
Not AI. AuI. Intelligence that works for you.

marketing_implications.target_audience: Everyone who is terrified of AI taking their job, their voice, their identity. Which is everyone.
marketing_implications.political_surface_area: Transcends left/right. Labor unions (jobs), traditionalists (human dignity), libertarians (local sovereignty), progressives (anti-corporate surveillance). Sweetbrier is the first AI brand that everyone can agree on.
